mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods of FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $400,000 million MoM indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in FEDFUNDS predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening financial conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 5.5% and PAYEMS growth is below 100,000 jobs per month, labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST below 900,000 units signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 30% of quarters with HOUST below 900,000.
